messages:
anita: quick follow-up on the credential naming & deprecation plan from yesterday's RFC. we need a concrete migration path for api keys -> token v2, and a naming scheme so console + SDKs don't explode. thoughts?

morgan: +1. critical to avoid breaking existing integrations. propose: keep apiKey v1 accepted for transition, prevent new v1 issuance immediately, deprecate after 90 days. soft-redirects would be confusing. we should offer an explicit exchange endpoint and telemetry.

alex: auto-mapping on the backend is tempting but risky for long-lived keys. prefer explicit upgrade: accept v1 but return a deprecation header and provide an /v1/exchange -> /v2 token flow. SDK/CLI should call exchange transparently on first use.

anita: ok exchange endpoint sounds good. what about service auth (internal svc tokens)? we have thousands of svc tokens that can't be rotated manually.

sam: for service tokens, do a staged rollout: accept both with logs tagging v1 usage, disallow new v1 issuance, and provide a bulk-exchange admin API. add a 'compat' flag for critical workloads that need more time. SRE: auto-rotate when possible.

leo: console UX note: surface 'migration_score' + 'recommended_action' per credential so customers know priority. also show expiry and offer one-click migrate for project owners.

alex: RBAC implication: ensure v2 tokens preserve the same actor/role bindings. we need an export tool to snapshot current bindings so exchange keeps identity consistent.

anita: here's a minimal exchange example the SDK could call:
```
# exchange v1 api key for token v2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credentials/exchange \
  -H "Authorization: ApiKey OLD_KEY" \
  -d '{"target_ttl":86400}'
```
Response should include new token, migration_score, and a deprecation header.

ops-bot: deploy-bot created rollout checklist: canary deploy exchange endpoint -> monitor 48h -> gradual 25/50/100. runbook link: https://go.redwood/cred-deprec-plan :white_check_mark:

morgan: one more tradeoff: naming scheme. we want human-readable + compact. proposal: `proj:env:purpose:hex` (hex = 8 chars). keep overall length <= 64. avoids leaking PII and is sortable.

alex: agree. also ensure SDKs normalize names in logs and obfuscate in public telemetry.

sam: migration tooling: I'll make a batch CLI to call the admin/exchange for service tokens and emit a CSV mapping old->new for audit. SRE will run it with `--dry-run` first.

anita: action items: 1) finalize exchange flow + response headers (owner: morgan) 2) naming scheme spec (owner: alex + leo for UX) 3) console flags + one-click migration (owner: leo) 4) bulk-migrate CLI + runbook (owner: sam) 5) telemetry events (cred.migrate.request, cred.v1.used) and alerts (owner: anita). i'll sketch a short rfc follow-up doc this afternoon. :thumbsup:

morgan: i'll draft the exchange API and deprecation headers today, pinging infra for rate-limit considerations.

alex: i'll start SDK PRs to auto-exchange and add deprecation header handling.

sam: prepping migration scripts and runbook; will coordinate a dry-run with SRE next week.

anita: thanks all. we'll hold a 30m sync after the draft rfc follow-up is posted. please drop any major objections here before EOD.

leo: tiny nit: include an escape hatch for orgs that need longer than 90 days (support ticket -> compat window). otherwise :+1:
